content.text: {"story":{"as_a":"user","i_want":"to edit an existing task and save the changes","so_that":"my task list stays accurate","business_description":"Users can change the details of a task they already created. The edit form reuses the create form, pre-fills the current values, and saves through the backend. Titles must be non-empty and at most 100 characters, and a Due Date cannot be earlier than the Creation Date.","business_value":"Users can correct and maintain their tasks without deleting and recreating them, which keeps the personal to-do list up to date.","acceptance_criteria":[{"given":"An existing task with a valid title and a Due Date not earlier than its Creation Date","when":"The user opens the edit form, changes the title, and submits the form","then":"The backend stores the new title and the task shows the new title in the list after the backend returns success"},{"given":"An existing task being edited in the form","when":"The user clears the title field and submits the form","then":"The backend rejects the update, the task keeps its previous title, and an error message stating that the title is mandatory is shown"},{"given":"An existing task being edited in the form","when":"The user enters a title of 101 characters and submits the form","then":"The backend rejects the update with a validation error, the stored title is unchanged, and an error message is shown"},{"given":"An existing task with Creation Date 2024-05-10","when":"The user sets the Due Date to 2024-05-09 and submits the update","then":"The backend rejects the update with a validation error, the stored Due Date is unchanged, and an error message is shown"},{"given":"A task update request where the backend returns an error","when":"The frontend receives the error response","then":"The frontend does not show the task as updated and displays an error message"},{"given":"A task update request where the backend returns success","when":"The frontend receives the success response","then":"The frontend displays a success message after the update action"},{"given":"A task ID that does not exist in the database","when":"An update request is sent for that ID","then":"The backend returns a Task Not Found error and no data is changed"}],"edge_cases":["A title of exactly 100 characters is accepted; a title of 101 characters or more is rejected.","A Due Date equal to the Creation Date is accepted; only a Due Date earlier than the Creation Date is rejected.","A title containing only spaces is not defined as empty in the PRD; this is an open question for the team.","The PRD does not list which fields an update may change or whether a missing Due Date is allowed; this is an open question for the team.","Status changes are handled by the change-status story, not by this story's update.","An update request for a non-existent task ID returns Task Not Found and changes no data.","A backend failure during update (internal or database error) leaves the stored task unchanged and the frontend shows an error, not a success state."],"dependencies":["US-create-task","US-view-task-list"],"definition_of_done":["The update endpoint for a task by ID validates the title (non-empty, at most 100 characters) and the Due Date (not earlier than the Creation Date) and returns a validation error when either rule fails.","The update endpoint returns Task Not Found for an unknown ID and changes no data.","Update errors for invalid input, missing mandatory fields, and internal or database errors return the simple error responses defined for the backend.","The edit form reuses the create form in edit mode and pre-fills the current values of the task.","The frontend shows a success message only after the backend returns success and an error message after a failed response, without showing the task as updated on failure.","Automated tests cover the successful update, empty title, title over 100 characters, Due Date before Creation Date, and unknown ID cases."]},"tasks":[{"key_slug":"task-update-endpoint","title":"[BE] Add update endpoint for a task by ID with validation and error responses","track":"backend","area":"backend","description":"Add the backend endpoint that updates an existing task by ID. Validate that the title is non-empty and at most 100 characters, and that the Due Date is not earlier than the Creation Date. Return Task Not Found for unknown IDs and the standard error responses for invalid input and database errors. Do not change stored data when validation fails.","size":"M","consumes_api":false,"touches_db":true,"requirement_ids":["R-bc3213df","R-244669c0","R-03df7815","R-efe1e5d4","R-0b1853d6","R-9dc414dc"],"is_spike":false,"definition_of_done":["Endpoint updates the stored task when the input is valid.","Empty titles and titles over 100 characters are rejected with a validation error and no data change.","A Due Date earlier than the Creation Date is rejected with a validation error and no data change.","Unknown task IDs return Task Not Found and no data change.","Database errors return the standard internal error response."]},{"key_slug":"task-edit-form","title":"[FE] Reuse task form in edit mode with existing values pre-filled","track":"frontend","area":"frontend","description":"Reuse the task creation form in edit mode. Load the current task values into the fields, submit changes to the update endpoint, and show a success or error message based on the backend response. Do not show the task as updated until the backend returns success.","size":"M","consumes_api":true,"touches_db":false,"requirement_ids":["R-9b30a145","R-d57336f7","R-ab9e9cb0"],"is_spike":false,"definition_of_done":["Opening edit mode shows the current values of the task in the form fields.","Submitting a valid change shows a success message only after the backend returns success.","Backend validation or other errors show an error message and the task is not shown as updated.","The empty title and title length rules are shown to the user before or upon submission."]},{"key_slug":"task-update-tests","title":"[QA] Test suite for editing an existing task","track":"qa_general","area":"qa","description":"Automated test suite covering the edit flow end to end: successful update, empty title, title over 100 characters, Due Date before Creation Date, unknown task ID, and success and error messages in the UI.","size":"S","consumes_api":true,"touches_db":false,"requirement_ids":["R-bc3213df","R-9b30a145","R-03df7815","R-efe1e5d4","R-d57336f7","R-244669c0","R-9dc414dc","R-0b1853d6","R-ab9e9cb0"],"is_spike":false,"definition_of_done":["Tests cover each acceptance criterion of the story.","Tests verify that a failed update does not show the task as updated.","Test suite runs in the team's continuous integration pipeline and passes."]}]}
